business_summary.text: Mumbai-focused residential developer building on ~100 acres of owned Thane land and seven asset-light JDA projects across MMR, including Bandra, BKC, Wadala, Sion, Mahim and Kandivali.

call_points.text: Management expects at least 20% growth in pre-sales and top-line for FY27.
EBITDA margin for FY27 is guided to be in a range-bound 16% to 18% on a blended basis.
Plans 2 new projects on own Thane land and 2 new JDA projects in Mumbai in FY27
JDA projects already account for 56% of annual pre-sales, two years ahead of schedule
FY26 EBITDA margin 16.3% versus 18.6% in FY25; Q4FY26 margin 21.5%
FY26 net operating cash flow was negative ₹1,053 Cr as approval and construction spend ran ahead of collections

operating_notes.text: Booking value reached ₹1,519 crore in Q4FY26, up 139% YoY.
Total potential revenue across the portfolio is ~₹42,000 Cr: ~₹25,000 Cr from ~100 acres of owned Thane land and ~₹17,000 Cr from 7 JDA projects.
Launched projects carry ₹7,602 Cr collected, ₹4,000 Cr pending collection from sold inventory and ₹14,098 Cr estimated unsold inventory value.
JDA portfolio comprises 7 projects with a combined revenue potential of approximately INR17,000 crores.

timeline.summary: Raymond Realty uploaded the audio recording of its investor conference for Q4 and FY26 results on May 6, 2026.
On May 12, 2026, Raymond Realty received BSE and NSE in-principle approval for issue, allotment and listing of 13,80,588 equity shares under the Raymond Realty Employees Stock Option Plan 2025.
Raymond Realty hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 6, 2026, highlighting a 29% rise in annual total income.
Raymond Realty incorporated Ten X Realty South Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on May 15, 2026.
Raymond Realty submitted clarifications to NSE regarding the EGM notice for preferential issue and warrant allocation.
Raymond Realty Limited schedules conference call on October 28, 2026, at 11:30 AM (IST) to discuss Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance.
Raymond Realty obtained in-principle stock exchange approval for preferential issue of 66,57,373 convertible warrants to promoters.
